items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 159
Price  2 sp (common, pitcher),  10 gp (fine, bottle); Weight 6 lbs. (common, pitcher), 1-1/2 lbs. (fine, bottle)
DescriptionWine is made from fermented fruit juice, usually grapes, but also sometimes berries, apples, or even rice (sake). The lower listed price is for unremarkable common wine and the higher is for significantly finer wine, though wine from certain vintners (and specific years) may fetch much higher prices. items.name: Swiveling Mithral Bayonet
items.description:
Category Two-Handed; Proficiency Simple

Weapon Groups Blades, Light; Close

Bayonets are close combat weapons designed to fit into the grooves or muzzles of crossbows and firearms.

To Extend / Retract: move-action

While Extended: -1 to hit with ranged shots, but you threat as melee and can make AoO. You still provoke when firing if you do not have improved Precise Shot.

items.name: Cloak of Resistance +2
items.description: This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

items.name: Sunrise
items.description:
This gold and silver plated heavy mace has a shining glass orb that appears to float in the center of its flanges. No dirt or blood will gather on its surfaces due to its constant prestidigitation effect.

This weapon is a +1 Heavy Mace of Divine Fire, dealing 1d8 base damage and an additional 1d6 divine to evil targets. Evil creatures who hold it suffer 1 negative level and 1d6 divine fire damage per round.

items.name: Bedroll
items.description: This consists of two woolen sheets sewn together along the bottom and one side to create a bag for sleeping in. Some have cloth straps along the open side so the bedroll can be tied closed while you are sleeping. It can be rolled and tied into a tight coil for storage or transport. Most people use a blanket with the bedroll to stay warm or provide a ground cushion.

items.name: Torch
items.description:
Price 1 cp; Weight 1 lb.

A torch burns for 1 hour, shedding normal light in a 20-foot radius and increasing the light level by one step for an additional 20 feet beyond that area (darkness becomes dim light and dim light becomes normal light). A torch does not increase the light level in normal light or bright light. If a torch is used in combat, treat it as a one-handed improvised weapon that deals bludgeoning damage equal to that of a gauntlet of its size, plus 1 point of fire damage.

items.name: 7.62x54mm Standard Cartridge
items.description: Standard ammunition for a bolt action sniper rifle.

items.name: Ladder, Folding
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 56, Adventurer's Armory pg. 19
Price 2 gp; Weight 16 lbs.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionThe hook, pole, and rungs of this 10-foot ladder are hinged, allowing you to fold it into a 3-foot-by-1-foot-by-1-foot bundle. Folding or unfolding it is a standard action.

items.name: Harrowstone Keys
items.description: Unlocks any doors in the cells of Harrowstone.

items.name: Wine, Sealord
items.description:
Wine, Sealord
Price 15 gp; Weight 1/2 lb.

These red and white wines grown in certain coastal vineyards have a sweet-tart flavor valued by nobles in many lands.

Beverages (Nonalcoholic)

items.name: Waterproof bag
items.description:
Waterproof bagSource Ultimate Equipment pg. 58, Adventurer's Armory pg. 19
Price  5 sp; Weight  1/2 lb.
Category Adventuring GearDescriptionThis leather sack sealed with tar or pitch keeps delicate items from being ruined by water. Items kept inside remain relatively dry, making the bag ideal for carrying maps, scrolls, spellbooks, and the like, although the bag is not impervious and can only be completely immersed for 10 rounds before enough water seeps in to ruin such items.

items.name: Caydenbrew
items.description:
Source Adventurer's Armory pg. 19
Price 5 cp/mug; Weight 1/2 lb.
Category Food/Drink
DescriptionThis ale is the standard beer drunk in Absalom. The recipe was said to be the last beer Cayden Cailean had before he undertook the Test of the Starstone. The hops for this beer were originally grown on the Isle of Kortos, but the massive brewery now imports from Andoran and Taldor.

items.name: Silver Longsword
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 18, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 142
StatisticsDamage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical 19-20/x2; Range -; Type S
Weapon Groups Blades, Heavy
DescriptionThis sword is about 3-1/2 feet in length.
Silver, Alchemical
A complex process involving metallurgy and alchemy can bond silver to a weapon made of steel so that it bypasses the damage reduction of creatures such as lycanthropes.

items.name: Chef's Masterwork Tools
items.description:
Price 50 gp; Weight 1 lb.

This tool is perfect for its intended job. It grants a +2 circumstance bonus on a related skill check (if any). The bonuses provided by multiple masterwork items do not stack.

Several common items already count as masterwork tools for particular skills. These are the alchemist's lab, climber's kit, disguise kit, healer's kit, masterwork musical instrument, and masterwork thieves' tools. Therefore, there is no masterwork climber's kit, masterwork healer's kit, and so

items.name: Nutonia, Luxury Spread by Calvin Carpenter
items.description:
Nutonia, Luxury Spread by Calvin Carpenter
Smear refinement in paste-form across the bread of your life. Nutonia is a nut butter made from the sack of the most robust harvest of Taldania-nuts. Taste the nut of a generational-talent.

items.name: Pirate clothes
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 89
Price  5 sp; Weight  2 lbs.
Category Clothing
DescriptionThis circle of water-resistant fabric (typically wool or leather) has a hooded opening in the center, making it easy to slip it on or off and protecting your entire body from rain or snow.

items.name: Manacles
items.description:
Source Path of the Hellknight pg. 15, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158, Ultimate Equipment pg. 57
Price  15 gp (common),  50 gp (masterwork),  1,000 gp (mithral); Weight 2 lbs. (common), 2 lbs. (masterwork), 2 lbs. (mithral)
DescriptionManacles can bind a Medium creature. A manacled creature can use the Escape Artist skill to slip free (DC 30, or DC 35 for masterwork manacles). Breaking the manacles requires a Strength check (DC 26, or DC 28 for masterwork manacles). Manacles have hardness 10 and 10 h

items.name: Scroll of Invisibility
items.description:
The creature or object touched becomes invisible. If the recipient is a creature carrying gear, that vanishes, too. If you cast the spell on someone else, neither you nor your allies can see the subject, unless you can normally see invisible things or you employ magic to do so.
Items dropped or put down by an invisible creature become visible; items picked up disappear if tucked into the clothing or pouches worn by the creature. Light, however, never becomes invisible, although a source of light

items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 22, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 142, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143

Statistics
Cost 1 gp Weight 1 lb.

Category Ammunition; Proficiency Ammunition

Description
A crossbow bolt used as a melee weapon is treated as a light improvised weapon (-4 penalty on attack rolls) and deals damage as a dagger of its size (critical multiplier x2). items.name: Tools, Thieves' (Masterwork)
items.description:
This kit contains lockpicks and other tools you need to use the @Compendium[pf1.skills.CCy1fajKKU3K02iQ]{Disable Device} skill. Without these tools, you must use improvised tools, and you take a -2 circumstance penalty on @Compendium[pf1.skills.CCy1fajKKU3K02iQ]{Disable Device} checks.

This kit contains extra tools and tools of better make, which grant a +2 circumstance bonus on @Compendium[pf1.skills.CCy1fajKKU3K02iQ]{Disable Device} checks.

A small steel mirror.

items.description: The subject can climb and travel on vertical surfaces or even traverse ceilings as well as a spider does. The affected creature must have its hands free to climb in this manner. The subject gains a climb speed of 20 feet and a +8 racial bonus on Climb skill checks; furthermore, it need not make Climb checks to traverse a vertical or horizontal surface (even upside down). items.name: Shovel, Common
items.description:
Source Adventurer's Armory pg. 19, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 2 cp; Weight 3 lbs.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionThis tool lets you dig a pit at a rate of 2 cubic feet per minute.

items.name: Supple, A Wine By Calvin Carpenter
items.description:
Calvin Carpenter's finest line of dry white wines, made from the finest potatoes from exclusive farms in Ravounel, has a name - Supple.
Enjoy a glass of premium and refined flavor.
Savor the taste and aroma of the rich, earthy notes in each bottle, expertly crafted from the finest ingredients. Raise a glass of Supple, the epitome of luxury and refinement.

items.name: Skein
items.description:
Skein is an Executioner's Scythe with symbols of Pharasma on the head and pommel and two empty gem sockets, one on each side of the blade.
A weapon forged before an ill-fated mission for what would be come the church of Pharasma. The champion that bore it returned alone, headless, strapped to his horse with this weapon still clutched in his hands. A warning to the Lady of Graves disciples to never underestimate their enemy.

While holding the weapon with both hands and touching a corpse, the wie

items.name: Outfit, Traveler's
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 89, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 159
Price  1 gp; Weight  5 lbs.
Category Clothing
DescriptionThis set of clothes consists of boots, a wool skirt or breeches, a sturdy belt, a shirt (perhaps with a vest or jacket), and an ample cloak with a hood.

items.name: Fishing Net
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 56, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 4 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Category Adventuring Gear
DescriptionThis net measures 5 feet by 5 feet, and can be used to cover a pit or to block Tiny or larger creatures from entering an area.

items.name: Outfit, Monk's
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 89, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 159
Price  5 gp; Weight  2 lbs.
Category Clothing
DescriptionThis simple outfit includes sandals, loose breeches, and a loose shirt, and is bound together with sashes. The outfit is designed to give you maximum mobility, and it's made of high-quality fabric. You can conceal small weapons in pockets hidden in the folds, and the sashes are strong enough to serve as short ropes.

items.name: Trail Rations
items.description:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 95, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 158
Price 5 sp; Weight 1 lb.
Category Food/Drink
DescriptionThe listed price is for a day's worth of food. This bland food is usually some kind of hard tack, jerky, and dried fruit, though the contents vary from region to region and the race of those creating it. As long as it stays dry, it can go for months without spoiling.
